source_title: Top news of the day: Kharge moves six charges against CEC at INDIA bloc’s ‘public impeachment’; AAP releases first list of 40 candidates for 2027 Punjab polls; and more
source_excerpt: Kharge moves six charges against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, says ‘no personal enmity’ The INDIA bloc’s ‘public impeachment’ of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar began on Saturday (October 31, 2026) at Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence on Rajaji Marg in New Delhi, with former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar chairing the proceedings. AAP announces first list of 40 candidates for 2027 Punjab Assembly elections The ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) on Saturday (October 31, 2026) released its first list of 40 candidates for the Punjab Assembly election due early next year, fielding only sitting MLAs. Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann will seek re-election from the Dhuri constituency in Sangrur district. AAP announces first list of 40 candidates for 2027 Punjab Assembly elections storyline 1 Low pressure over Andaman Sea intensifies further The low pressure area over south and north Andaman Sea moved west-northwestwards and intensified into a well-marked low pressure at 5.30 a.m. on Saturday (October 31, 2026) .According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), Amaravati, the well-marked low pressure is centred near southeast Bay of Bengal as of Saturday (October 31, 2026) morning. The system may further move west-northwestwards and concentrate into a depression near the Andhra Pradesh coast by the night. Low pressure over Andaman Sea intensifies further storyline 1 ISRO NVS-03 launch: 5 things to know about India’s new navigation satellite India’s independent regional navigation satellite system NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation) was restored to its minimum operational configuration of four satellites on Friday (October 30, 2026) as ISRO successfully launched its 2,250 kg navigation satellite NVS-03 from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. ISRO NVS-03 launch: 5 things to know about India’s new navigation satellite storyline 1 Society that accepts unverified claims and fears questions is vulnerable to authoritarianism: Justice Bhuyan Supreme Court judge Justice Ujjal Bhuyan said a society that accepts claims without evidence, fears questions and treats tradition as beyond question becomes vulnerable to misinformation, defenceless in the face of authoritarianism and fails to reform unjust practices. Justice Bhuyan said building a scientific temper enshrined in Article 51A of the Constitution should not be confined to laboratories but extend to the capacity of youths and students to think rationally as members of a civil and political society. Society that accepts unverified claims and fears questions is vulnerable to authoritarianism: Justice Bhuyan storyline 1 Petrol export duty cut to nil, diesel levy raised by ₹3 a litre The government on Saturday (October 31, 2026) slashed the export duty on petrol to nil while hiking the levy on export of diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by ₹3 per litre and 50 paise per litre respectively for the next 15-day period. There was no change in the existing excise duty rates for petrol and diesel for domestic consumption. Diesel exports would now draw a levy of ₹11.5 for every litre against ₹8.5 per litre it drew in the previous fortnight. Petrol export duty cut to nil, diesel levy raised by ₹3 a litre storyline 1 Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as new Chief of Air Staff Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, an accomplished fighter pilot with over 3,500 hours of flying experience on over 20 types of aircraft, on Saturday (October 31, 2026) assumed charge as the new Chief of Air Staff. He succeeded Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh who superannuated from the force after a 43-year-long illustrious career. Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as new Chief of Air Staff storyline 1 Union Minister Rijiju challenges Congress to answer ‘basic questions’ amid row over SIR, CEC Union Minister Kiren Rijiju on Saturday (October 31, 2026) challenged the Congress to explain its electoral defeats while questioning its criticism of the Election Commission and opposition to the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, accusing the party of trying to undermine the Constitution and democracy. Union Minister Rijiju challenges Congress to answer ‘basic questions’ amid row over SIR, CEC storyline 1 Dhruv Rathee defamation case: Delhi Court issues fresh bailable warrants A Delhi Court on Saturday (October 31, 2026) issued fresh bailable warrants against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee in a 2018 defamation case. Judicial Magistrate Rahul Jain issued the fresh warrants against Mr. Rathee in a case filed by Vikas Sanskrityayan alias Vikas Pandey, who accused the YouTuber of defamation over a video uploaded on his channel. The detailed order is awaited. Iran’s Supreme Leader warns U.S., Israel against new attacks storyline 1 G20 foreign ministers to end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues Top diplomats from the Group of 20 (G20) largest world economies will wrap up two days of talks in Atlanta on Saturday (October 31, 2026) without reaching consensus on several critical global security issues, after divisions, notably over Russia’s war with Ukraine, overshadowed the start of the meeting.
